rationale: Voltage drops below sag_upper_pu (0.9) at 40 ms, remains between 0.1 and 0.9 pu through 100 ms, and returns above 0.9 pu at 120 ms; minimum 0.58 pu exceeds interruption threshold 0.1 pu, so the contiguous non-normal interval is a voltage sag. Duration = (100-40) ms + one 20 ms sample interval = 80 ms = 0.08 s.
